_comment: Product parts built from CAD (Day 6/7). make_part_variants.ps1 writes usd/<part>_<variant>.usda (final shape) and, for processed parts, usd/<part>_<variant>_raw.usda (before processing), as reference + override layers on the converted USD (never edited). Paths relative to the converted asset's default prim; paint_prims '*' = every mesh. Paint colours are simulation choices. Optional per part: spawn_interval_s, camera (fixed inspection camera height above the belt and focal length), cell (inline inspection cell: camera on the 5-axis machine, views and timing).

crown._comment: Dental crown inspection cell (Day 11): finished crowns (milled upstream) ride the conveyor into the 5-axis machine, which carries a camera on its spindle instead of a tool. B/C tilt and turn the crown on the platter for a top view and four side views. Our own CadQuery models (scripts/make_dental_parts.ps1), real size. Zirconia ivory vs wrong material (pink); shape = uncut corner of blank material; chip = notch at the margin of one side wall (invisible from the top).

cell._comment: standoff_m: camera to crown centre; roi_half_m: inspection window half size on that plane. Timing in seconds of simulation time.
